title: point-charges
description:
This study reports computer-certified counts of equilibrium points of the electrostatic potential of a handful of point charges, compared with Maxwell's 1873 bound of at most (n-1)^2 points.

Exact counts, all non-degenerate, are 4 for 3 charges, 9 for 4 charges, 24 for 5 charges, 29 for 6 charges, and 44 for 7 charges, the last proved by the independent verifier only for now.

Evidence, not proof: no three-charge configuration with more than 4 equilibria, and no four-charge configuration with more than 9, turned up in the searches described in the notes. The work was not reviewed by a person.

Directed by Ahraz Arifuddin

Researched and verified by different model families across Gemini, Claude, Grok, OpenAI, and Muse
